description.value: Hot Buns Bakery is a café and bakery situated on Village Stroll in the heart of Whistler Village, known for its cinnamon buns, crepes, coffee, and house-made rotating-flavour gelato. Its central location on a pedestrian stroll makes it a natural rest point for cyclists passing through Whistler. The friendly atmosphere and sweet-and-savoury menu cater well to riders looking to refuel mid-tour.
